Ubharte kalakar – kantent krietar se jharkhand ki sanskriti aur pahchan ki aavaj banne tak ka saphar | aman kachchhap ki prernadayak kahani | DD JHARKHAND
Jharkhand ki pahchan yahan ke janglon, paharon aur khanij sanpda ke sath-sath iski samriddh janjatiy sanskriti, lokgit, loknrity aur paranpraon men bhi basti hai. is sanskritik virasat ko dijital duniya ke jarie desh-duniya tak pahunchane ka kam kar rahe hain yuva kantent krietar aman kachchhapa.
